notes: Single deliverable chain: author a modelling program, tune it against the visible feature/target matrices, and emit a per-seed held-out rank-accuracy report. reasoning_depth=3: the sensor-response surface is strongly nonlinear (smooth sinusoid + quadratic + pairwise interaction + Gaussian bump + skew-root terms), so a naive linear regression lands around Spearman ~0.55-0.60 on held-out rows and even an untuned RandomForest min-over-seeds ~0.85-0.89 - both below the 0.92 gate - so the agent must genuinely tune features/model (e.g. a properly configured gradient-boosting ensemble reaches min-over-seeds ~0.94+) and prove it across 10 independent random holdouts. quantitative_correctness=3: the verifier re-executes the program and recomputes Spearman from the emitted per-seed test_pred against the ground-truth target at test_ids; every seed must clear 0.92, holdouts must be real (test fraction in [0.1,0.3]), distinct across seeds, and the report schema exact. hidden_case_generalization=3: the program is re-executed on two fresh fab runs of the same relationship family (different n, d and noise draw) plus a shape-mismatched pair and a missing-file probe that must exit non-zero; visible fixtures are sha-pinned against tampering. debugging_ambiguity=2: the relationship is undocumented and the failure modes (under-fit linear model, unstable vanilla forest) must be diagnosed from the per-seed Spearman spread. dependency chain is short (one program, one report) and there is no environment pressure.
